verdict.rationale: BigQuery's native GoogleSQL is documented as ANSI-compliant, with procedural extensions and pipe syntax built in, so no bolt-on extensions are needed. A hands-on report confirms that iterating on arrays, parsing JSON and using QUALIFY (which implies window functions) all work natively. However, the first-party evidence never explicitly documents window functions, CTEs or the date/time type system, so much of the story rests on inference from ANSI compliance plus one community report. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of window functions, CTEs, JSON/ARRAY/STRUCT types and rich date/time types, plus broader independent corroboration.
